forSuppliers.title: Buyers are already searching. Make sure they find you accurately.
forSuppliers.intro: Suplymate lists manufacturers, wholesalers, and distributors so buyers can compare them side by side. Your company may already be listed from public sources — claiming it lets you correct the details and respond to sourcing requests.
forSuppliers.coverageSummary: {suppliers, number} companies are listed across {countries, number} countries and {categories, number} categories.
forSuppliers.step1Text: Search the directory for your company name. Listings are built from publicly available business information, so many companies are already there.
forSuppliers.step2Text: Tell us you represent the company and we review the request. Once approved you can correct your address, categories, and contact details.
forSuppliers.step3Text: Buyers send requests for quotes through the platform. You reply with pricing and lead times directly.
forSuppliers.honestyTitle: What listing does and does not mean
forSuppliers.honestyListed: Listed means we hold public business information about your company. It is not an endorsement and it is not a verification.
forSuppliers.honestyVerified: Verified is a separate status that requires a person to confirm the company details. Most listings are not verified, and we label them accordingly.
forSuppliers.honestyNoPayment: Paying us does not change your listing status, your position in search results, or your verification badge.
forSuppliers.claimText: Send us the details and we will add or correct the listing. There is no charge for this.
forSuppliers.waitlistSuccess: You're on the list. We'll email you when supplier tools open up.

faq.title: 常见问题
faq.intro: Réponses aux 问题s les p已读s 常见. Besoin d'帮助 ? Consultez 我们的centre d'帮助 ou 联系-nous.
faq.a1: Suplymate est une place de 市场 B2B de sourcing和d'approvisionnement propulsée par l'IA用于发现 des 供应商, envoyer des RFQ, 比较 des 报价和consulter des 价格 参考.
faq.a2: 您pouvez créer un 账户和探索 la 平台. Certaines 功能 可能 faire 参与方 d'方案 付费 décrites sur la 页 tarifs.
faq.q3: Comment fonctionne la 验证 des 供应商 ?
faq.a3: La 验证 est un 流程 手动 par 我们的团队 管理. Consultez 我们的政策 de 验证用于le 周期 完整.
faq.a4: 您发送 une 请求 de 报价 描述 vos 需要s. Les 供应商 回复ent avec des 报价 comparables 并排.
faq.q5: D'où viennent les 数据 de 价格 ?
faq.a5: L'情报 价格 est 参考和provient de 来源 公开和第三方. Confirmez tou天 les 价格 直接 avec les 供应商.
faq.q6: Comment 认领 le profil de mon entreprise ?
faq.a6: 联系ez-nous à info@suplymate.com depuis une adresse e-mail 企业用于认领 您的fiche.
faq.q7: Comment sont 管理 les avis ?
faq.a7: Les avis sont autorisés 之后 une 互动 符合条件 sur la 平台. Tous les avis sont 已审核. Voir 我们的政策 des avis.
faq.q8: Suplymate offre-t-il 保护 de 付款 ou 退款 ?
faq.a8: 不。Suplymate ne traite pas les 付款s entre 买家和供应商. Voir 我们的政策 de 退款和保护.
